description: 'The paper form must be returned by 11/01/2026' is a deadline even though 'returned' is past-participle in form.

input.text:
CEDAR COUNTY BENEFITS
It is time to renew your benefits.
The benefits you need to renew have a check-mark next to them:
[x] SNAP
Due dates:
The paper form must be returned by 11/01/2026.
Items we need from you: send copies.
• Proof of income: last 4 pay stubs.
